messages:
erin: RCA posted for the mid-week serving latency blip — link: https://redwood.internal/rca/2250000000-serving-latency-blip
sam: thanks erin. quick ask: is the short-term mitigation the same TTL bump we talked about?
maria: yes, TTL bump + config tweak. owner: @maria. I attached the patch in the doc.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: 04:00 UTC. Manual trigger by @maria. Targets: 10% of headpool.
maria: I'll kick the canary and report back here. cc @ops @sre
ops: please add the minimal validation checklist into the RCA so anyone running the canary can follow it without digging.
erin: added a 3-step canary check in the doc:
```
1) replay 5m prod tail
2) p95 < 500ms vs baseline
3) eviction_rate decreased >= 25%
```
jae: I'll own the alert for cache-threshold regressions and post the query later today.
priya: prepping the customer-facing blurb for statuspage; will mark impact as "limited" unless we escalate.
luis: add rollback criteria to the canary notes: abort if p95 > 650ms or error_rate increase > 0.5%.
erin: assigning follow-ups in the doc: Maria run canary (due 2026-04-03), Jae alert PR (due 2026-04-10), Priya status update (due 2026-04-07).
ops: can we set a 30m checkpoint next Monday to review progress? erin, can you host?
erin: yes — scheduled Mon 2026-04-06 15:00 PT. invite sent.
maria: starting canary at 04:00 UTC; will post metrics shortly.
infra-bot: rca-published link=https://redwood.internal/rca/2250000000-serving-latency-blip tags=[reliability,cache,canary]
erin: please comment on the doc if anything missing; we'll reopen RCA if new findings surface."
